description: List the email addresses your workspace's alert rules can send to: each has an id, address, label and status (pending until the address owner clicks the link in the verification email, then verified). An alert is only sent to a verified address. Takes no parameters. Use when: the user asks where alerts go, or why an address gets nothing. Read-only. Needs notifications:read. Only a person signed in to the nopaque web app can call this; an API key is refused.
name: listNotificationDestinations
title: List Alert Destinations
